overview.description: The NYLIM MacKay California Muni Intermediate ETF (MMCA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests primarily in investment-grade, intermediate-term municipal bonds that are exempt from federal and California income taxes. MMCA was launched on Dec 21, 2021 and is issued by NYLIM.
